title: On a phone, the new Send invites button squeezes the session title to one word per line
where: /admin/sessions/[code] Overview header (SessionHeader actions), 390px, admin, open session with a long topic
what_happens: With Send invites, Copy join link and Archive all in the header row, the title gets about 75px: the topic runs to 10 lines, one word each, and the code/status/date line breaks into 5 lines. Before this PR the same header showed the title in 4 normal lines.
who_hurts: An admin opening a session on their phone sees a tall column of single words before any results, and the results start below the first screen.
suggested_fix: Let the actions wrap under the title on narrow screens (e.g. header row flex-col sm:flex-row in session-header.tsx), or show Send invites as an icon-only button below sm with an aria-label.
rule: general: the page must work at phone width; established pattern: the same header before this PR
